description: This file defines the high-level API for mirror functions in the RTL8367/RTL8367C switch, including setting and getting port mirroring, port isolation, VLAN leaky features, packet format keep modes, and override controls.

methods.name: rtk_mirror_portBased_set
methods.description: Configures port-based mirroring by setting the monitor port and corresponding RX/TX mirror port masks.

methods.name: rtk_mirror_portBased_get
methods.description: Retrieves the current port-based mirroring configuration, including monitor port and mirror port masks.

methods.name: rtk_mirror_portIso_set
methods.description: Enables or disables mirror port isolation, preventing normal forwarding to the mirror port.

methods.name: rtk_mirror_portIso_get
methods.description: Gets the current status of mirror port isolation.

methods.name: rtk_mirror_vlanLeaky_set
methods.description: Enables or disables VLAN leaky forwarding for mirror VLAN traffic for TX and RX.

methods.name: rtk_mirror_vlanLeaky_get
methods.description: Retrieves current VLAN leaky settings for mirror traffic.

methods.name: rtk_mirror_isolationLeaky_set
methods.description: Configures leaky behavior for mirror port isolation for TX and RX traffic.

methods.name: rtk_mirror_isolationLeaky_get
methods.description: Gets the status of mirror port isolation leaky settings.

methods.name: rtk_mirror_keep_set
methods.description: Sets the mode for maintaining packet format in mirror mode, such as VLAN follow or original.

methods.name: rtk_mirror_keep_get
methods.description: Retrieves the current mirror packet format keep mode.

methods.name: rtk_mirror_override_set
methods.description: Configures mirror override behavior, controlling whether packets are output as mirrored, normal, or ACL-mirrored.

methods.name: rtk_mirror_override_get
methods.description: Retrieves the current mirror override configuration.
